name: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0
storyline: The great world tree, Yggdrasil, has long stood watch over the world, providing shelter and bounty for its people. However, the arrival of Dark Lord Asmodeus has Yggdrasil and the world at large on the brink of ruin. In their desperation, the people call upon an ancient ritual to summon a hero to save them. That hero is none other than Illumina.
summary:
The Heroic Tale of Illumina is a straightforward turn-based RPG. Set in a classic fantasy world, it showcases Illumina's struggles to defeat four of Dark Lord Asmodeus's most fearsome archdemons. Experience a variety of encounters, meet a range of colorful characters, and outsmart your enemies to save the world you were summoned to defend!

The game features thrilling turn-based combat, challenging battles, and a simple, easy-to-understand gameplay loop.
